protocol.react: React 19.3 + React Compiler with keyed row components owning useState
protocol.runtime: OXC-generated component and state-site metadata; structural updates expand the dirty owner subtree and use an LIS-based keyed VDOM move plan
protocol.timing: Programmatic click to synchronous host commit; mount reported separately; layout, paint, and display presentation excluded.

limitations: Three page loads share one Chrome 154 profile and one MacIntel device; each page is the replication unit and 24 pairs are nested observations.
The LIS plan minimizes retained host moves for the computed keyed sequence; it still normalizes and scans the sibling sequence and does not use the dependency DAG to select structural intervals.
React Compiler is enabled; source render counters are omitted to avoid changing compiler memoization.
Three fresh page loads share one Chrome 154 profile and one MacIntel device; more independent device/browser replications are needed.
The benchmark excludes layout, paint, display presentation, repeated churn memory, and lifecycle instrumentation.
OXC lowers the checked-in TSX component and state-site fixture; the structural operation callback is supplied by the harness.
